meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取当前分支的 PR/MR 上的 Qodo 审查意见,按严重度列出问题,并可在你确认后逐一或批量修复代码、对每条内联评论回复决定、提交并推送改动。
howto.when: 当你说出“qodo pr resolver”“pr resolver”等关键词,或要求查看/修复 Qodo 的代码审查意见时触发。需当前分支有已打开且 Qodo 已审查过的 PR/MR。

say.text: 帮我看一下 Qodo 对这个 PR 的审查意见
自动修复所有标记为 Fix 的 Qodo 问题
say.note: Claude 会按 Qodo 的修复说明批量改代码并提交。

say.text: 逐个处理 Qodo 指出的问题,先看最严重的
say.note: Claude 会逐条展示问题并等你确认后再改。

howto.what_en: Claude will fetch Qodo review comments for the current branch's PR/MR, list issues by severity, then fix them individually or in batch with your approval, reply to each inline comment, commit and push.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "qodo pr resolver" or "pr resolver", or ask to view/fix Qodo code review issues. Requires an open PR/MR on the current branch that Qodo has already reviewed.

say_en.text: Show me Qodo's review comments for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and list the Qodo issues.

say_en.text: Auto-fix all Qodo issues marked as Fix.
say_en.note: Claude will apply fixes per Qodo's prompts and commit.

say_en.text: Walk me through Qodo issues one by one.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your approval before each fix.
